evidenceBasis: Separate account-fact consumption authority registry for the exact KIS PAPER provider tuple. It is committed EMPTY: no consumption record is ratified, no consumer is granted, and no approval evidence exists. With zero records every resolve is blocked and portfolio_account_fact/3 production stays unreachable, exactly as before this registry existed. A future record can authorize read-only account-fact production and validation only; it can never authorize Portfolio Risk Input, sizing, Stage, Buy, Action, Order, Production, Trading, or REAL use, and the mechanism refuses any record whose authority block says otherwise.
